title: The saffron spice market
alt: Saffron and coral spices fill a richly painted Moroccan market.
description: Layered oil painting with brass bowls, patterned textiles and a sunlit market street.
prompt: A richly textured oil painting of a Moroccan spice market, saffron-yellow and coral-red spice mounds in brass bowls, woven baskets, elaborate patterned textiles, shadowed arched stalls and warm shafts of sun. Tiny distant shoppers remain secondary to the detailed still-life foreground. Confident painterly impasto, warm ochre with turquoise accents, believable bowls and market architecture, no readable writing.
